SourceProxy.name: SHYXResampleLines
SourceProxy.label: SHYX Resample Lines

Documentation.short_help: SHYX Resample Lines: Resample a polyline network at a fixed spacing; keep junctions and short branches.

SourceProxy.Documentation: Optional Fuse merges points closer than Fuse Tolerance (default 1e-6 of the longest bounding-box side) so nearly coincident endpoints share a vertex. Vertices whose line degree is not 2 are features and are kept. Each branch is resampled at Sample Distance along arc length. If that distance is greater than or equal to the branch length, both endpoints are kept as one segment (short branches are not deleted). Closed loops with no features are resampled around the cycle; a loop shorter than the spacing keeps its original vertices.

IntVectorProperty.name: Fuse
IntVectorProperty.label: Fuse
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Merge points closer than Fuse Tolerance before walking the line graph, so nearby branch ends become one vertex and the network stays connected.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: FuseTolerance
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Fuse Tolerance
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Absolute merge distance. 0 (default) uses 1e-6 times the longest side of the input axis-aligned bounding box (matches BoundsDomain scaled_extent). The panel Scale/Reset controls fill that suggestion. Ignored when Fuse is off.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: SampleDistance
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Sample Distance
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Arc-length spacing on each branch. 0 uses 0.01 times the longest bounding-box side (BoundsDomain scaled_extent). If the spacing is >= branch length, only the two endpoints are kept.
